name: Kusho
source:
An elf assassin. Charming fellow, good with a bow. Has something of a code of honor, he's the kind to turn down a job on moral grounds. That policy makes him a bit polarizing, as assassins go.
Kusho's usually the sort to leave a calling card when finishing a job. A corrupt nobleman here, a wanted criminal there, he'll leave a way for people to get in touch if they admire his work. And besides that, he likes the recognition. he has a bit of an ego.
